quote.text: The improver of natural knowledge absolutely refuses to acknowledge authority, as such. For him, scepticism is the highest of duties; blind faith the one unpardonable sin.
quote.author: Thomas Henry Huxley, “On the Advisableness of Improving Natural Knowledge” (1866)

stories.kicker: The Atelier · Reading Lamps and Bedside Light
stories.headline: The one rule that measured flicker expired in March
stories.dek: It was inactivated on 26 March 2026 and nothing replaced it. At the only maker publishing a flicker figure, the flicker-free bulb is the one you cannot dim.

stories.headline: Two needles, one thread, and each pass locks the last
stories.dek: The saddle stitch cannot be made by machine, which is why a hobby of 888,000 people still turns on a hand tool. One of the four makers everyone wants is in Singapore.

stories.kicker: Departures · The Link and the Certificate
stories.headline: Built, tested, and still not allowed to carry anyone
stories.dek: The cross-border rail link slips to February 2027. The infrastructure is “substantially complete”; the testing is not, and after that comes an independent assessor's certificate.

stories.headline: The prize and the designation, hours apart
stories.dek: Navi Pillay won it in Oslo on Friday morning. By Friday evening Washington had listed the International Criminal Court itself — the first time the court, and not a judge, has been designated.

stories.headline: Nothing free opens below two hundred
stories.dek: The island's worst region peaked at 192 on Friday evening and held there four hours. Every piece of free relief announced that afternoon begins above 200.

stories.headline: Six hundred million, two days before the hearing
stories.dek: Micron licensed Netlist's portfolio on 5 October. On the 6th the trade commission terminated the parallel case against Samsung, Google and Supermicro. The evidentiary hearing was set for 23 November.

stories.kicker: The Kit · A Constant Aperture at 390 Grams
stories.headline: Everything measured here was measured by its maker
stories.dek: Sigma's 50-120mm F2.8 was announced on Wednesday at $799 and ships on the 22nd. No independent bench has touched it, and nobody has published a Singapore price.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · One of Eight, in Steel
stories.headline: A million dollars for a thirty-nine-millimetre watch
stories.dek: The Voutilainen 28Sport closed on Friday at 8.47 times its low estimate. Forty-eight hours earlier, a tourbillon at a fifteenth of the price found no bid at all.

stories.headline: A nineteen-million horror beat Sorkin five to one
stories.dek: Other Mommy took $3.6m on Thursday against The Social Reckoning's $650,000 in previews. Neither film has an audience score yet; both are still counting critics.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Twelve Thousand Children
stories.headline: Twenty-six minutes a day buys 0.04 of a standard deviation
stories.dek: The largest device-measured study of its kind reports small, unstable effects — and finds more sitting associated with slightly lower blood pressure. General guidance, not medical advice.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · A Model That Stopped Working
stories.headline: Real yields fell, and gold fell with them
stories.dek: For three issues the real-yield share explained nearly all of gold's move. On the only fully published window this week it explains none, and the sign is inverted.

stories.kicker: Fitness · Grip Plateaus, Fitness Does Not
stories.headline: Your watch is about three millilitres optimistic
stories.dek: A validation study measured twenty runners before and after twelve weeks. The watch read high both times, then promised a half-marathon seven and a half minutes faster than they ran.

stories.headline: Japan is already selling January. Singapore has not priced it
stories.dek: Every row below was re-checked against a venue, promoter or official seller. Nine candidates failed verification and are named at the foot.

stories.headline: Eight hundred thousand drivers, eleven thousand rides
stories.dek: India built the largest driver-owned ride-hailing cooperative on earth and it is doing 11,106 trips a day. Read as a business that is a catastrophe. It is not a business.
